coordinates: PDF points, origin top-left, y grows downward. Rule in the picture: its x extent, y1 = bottom of the rule, y0 = y1 - 10.
how_measured: Each page is one scanned picture (623 px wide, 96 ppi) with no text layer. The drawing matrix flips the stored picture vertically (page 1: 467.04 0 0 -482.88 72 696.96 cm; pages 2-4: 467.52 0 0 -604.8 72 720; pages 5-6: 467.28 0 0 -604.32 72 720), so the picture was flipped back and mapped as x = 72 + col * w/623, y = top + row * h/H (page 1 top 95.04, h 482.88, H 644; page 5 top 72, h 604.32, H 806). Rules found in the pixels (rows darker than 200, 12 px or longer); every page looked at at 100 and 130 dpi; overlays looked at.

signing.kind: Scanned subscription form: the purchaser completes and signs page 1 (individual or authorized signatory line), the company accepts at its foot; the purchaser also signs the risk acknowledgement form on page 5.

sure_per_page.1: sure (the two caption-less rules are read as second lines of the address above them)

1: the frames: the thick box around the share sentence (y about 154 and 200), the box of the registration/delivery instructions and the box of the signature block (their edges at y about 228, 352, 370, 493)
"EXHIBIT 99.1" (a real text line above the picture)
4: "Offering Memorandum of the Issuer dated ●" on page 2 and similar bullet placeholders: the issuer's, completed before sending
5: the frame of the form (top y about 147, bottom y about 421) and the rotated word "WARNING" beside it (its letters show as short strokes)
the underlined e-mail address of the issuer in the cancellation notice (a link, printed)
